name: sdlc
description: SDLC — the complete software development lifecycle as gaps the engine cannot fill on its own (skillwise four-atom discipline: Knowledge / Capability / Judgment / Control, no step-marches). Twenty-eight skills organised as nine rings + a spine (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md). Since v0.6.0 the plugin reads itself through the loop-engineering / graph-engineering lens (docs/proposals/loop-graph-engineering.md): the execution graph and the six loop contracts are data (`assets/graph.yaml` linted by verify_graph.py — bounded writes, every cycle owned by a loop, evaluator→implementer edges carry only fix_prompt, human nodes have resume bindings, fan-in has merge; `assets/loops.yaml` linted by verify_loop.py — generator ≠ verifier, stop = success/convergence/budget/impossible), every loop is bound to a native trigger (`assets/triggers.yaml`: /goal, /loop, Stop hook, /schedule), convergence detection grew from same-fingerprint×2 to oscillation / plateau / impossible_under_contract (routing.yaml v2 R14–R16, `fail --score --by`), `check-clean --as-hook` + a Stop-hook template refuse to end a session with a pending failure report or dirty cards, the ledger gained a typed-edge sidecar `trace.jsonl` (caused_by / decided_by / supersedes / implements / references / depends_on / rejected_alternative; `trace.py why|impact|render|lint`; retro reads escape causal chains and contract rework from it), `/pr --pre-review` runs ≤2 isolated self-review rounds and documents survivors under Known issues, and the new `/tune` skill closes the hill-climbing loop: traces → harness-parameter proposals (closed target set) → diff/patch → human PR, never auto-applied. Delivery spine (original): `/sdlc` (lifecycle orchestrator: SKILL.state-style state file whose transitions are validated by a script, WikiSkill-style append-only ledger, routing.yaml with per-layer budgets + fingerprint termination, three human-only gates G1 world-adjudication / G2 done_when hash-freeze / G3 exception review), `/issue` (requirement or bug → falsifiable GitHub issue: PSL-vs-TASK dual track, DOS vocabulary closure, acceptance in done_when-v2 shape gated by verify_issue.py), `/commit` (atomic Conventional Commit gated by verify_commit.py: message grammar, card whitelist, G2 lock hash, secret + debug-code scan), `/pr` (PR body in product order with AC→evidence mapping, size classes, XL must split; verify_pr.py), `/review-loop` (zero-token blocking wait via pr-poll.sh, reviewer comments as claims to verify, ACCEPT/REJECT/REPLY/ESCALATE/SKIPPED, reply-before-resolve, per-thread strikes, compiled termination; adapted from vana-builder), `/pr-review` (Detective Loop, reproduction for P0/P1, 5-finding cap, A/B/C tiers, posts a GitHub review, never approves), `/plan-cards` (L4: contract → self-contained task cards, lint_cards.py), `/implement` (L6: isolated implementer sees only card + AC subset + red baseline; whitelist executor; fingerprint escalation), `/release` (L8 delivery: SemVer from commits, changelog ↔ tag ↔ notes consistency, rollback before deploy, verified-green before done; verify_release.py), `/retro` (X3 learning: baseline → reflow distribution → proposals routed to psl / dos / invariant / ac / routing / skill; metrics.py). Single contract schema: done_when.yaml v2 (AC-first, v1 superset) validated by validate_done_when_v2.py inside `advance g2`, v1 bridged by convert_v1_to_v2.py, two-stage lock (g2 criteria / l5 tests). Upper half — build the world (from looper, wired): `/psl` (experiential requirement → six-layer Product Specification Language under a three-provenance honesty discipline, verify_psl.py), `/psl-derive` (new: PSL → dos-proposal / workflow / form-draft with every decision citing a PSL-ID + N-run divergence set as the G1 agenda, verify_derived.py). Cross-cutting X1 (from looper): `/dos-extract` (code+docs → 12-section dos.yaml + decisions.md, four classification judgments, verify_dos.py), `/invariant-extract` (abductive + deductive recovery of a territory's □ invariants, propose-only hard invariants, verify_card.py). Contract and standards (from qanat, term-mapped): `/donewhen-extract` (issue intent → falsifiable done_when card: adjectives→thresholds, happy/unhappy twins, contradiction + coverage checks, verify_done_when.py), `/spec-compile` (decidability ladder: fitness fn / eval_case example+property+metamorphic / PAJAMA judge program, verify_compile.py), `/calibrate` (the standard's standard: mutation score, Krippendorff α ≥ 0.80, holdout, isolation — verify_calibration.py). Acceptance line (from this repo's done-when-pipeline v1.1.0 + ratchet, wired): `/acceptance-spec` (NL → EARS spec + done_when.yaml + spec-robustness), `/test-suite-generator` (5-layer pyramid batch-by-card), `/code-reviewer` / `/qa-reviewer` / `/pm-reviewer` / `/spec-drift-detector` / `/spec-gaming-detector` (the six independent review skills), `/meta-judge` (synthesis, hard wall), `/acceptance-fleet` (parallel dispatch → four-state ratchet DONE / FIX / SPEC_DRIFT / GAMING_RISK mapped onto routing.yaml), `/ratchet` (master-evaluates / worker-executes loop for cards that must run to green). Reconciles Spec Loop v1.2 × done_when Pipeline end to end (U1–U3/G1, L1–L8/G2/G3, X1–X3); only forge-teams / pdforge (implementation executors) remain optional neighbours. All skills static_only (22 scripts smoke-tested on fixtures; behavioural delta unverified).
